status: retrospective, unregistered: decided 2026-10-24 after all results were known; in no pre-registration

1.why_not_checked: 7.29 drew its fold-1 views before anything seeded torch, and torch's default seed on this install is time-based (two fresh processes draw different numbers), so those views cannot be recreated. Fold 1's replay value is computed and reported, not checked. Its weight equality IS checked.

any_checkpoint_max_descriptive.no_interval_no_contrast: a maximum over noisy reads has a positive null (7.28): the maximum of 16 noisy reads is positive whether or not any gap exists

lambda0_step4000_s729_vs_main.disclosure: The main tables' λ=0 step-4000 gaps differ from 7.29's because the views differ (no augmentation here vs one weak-augmented view in 7.29). Both sets are reported side by side. These values are not directly comparable with BNM's logged gaps (7.28), which used weak-augmented views.

interpretation.sentence: Whether part of the adaptation gain comes from fitting these particular target images remains undetermined: DANN − λ=0 = +0.0987 [−0.2113, +0.4086] at the read-off step.
interpretation.secondary_statement: Secondary reading (the within-fold mean over the 16 checkpoints; it is the secondary, not the primary): DANN − λ=0 = +0.0779 [−0.0832, +0.2390].
interpretation.always: In every case: no multiplicity correction, and the intervals are probably too narrow because the folds' target pools overlap (paper §5.3).
